sections.heading: EB-2 Final Action Dates advanced 90 days for three chargeability areas
paragraphs: In the November 2026 Visa Bulletin, EB-2 Final Action Dates (Table A) advanced for 3 of 5 chargeability areas and held steady for 2. All other countries, Mexico and the Philippines each moved up 90 days (≈3.0 months), from Jan 1, 2025 in the October 2026 bulletin to Apr 1, 2025. That was the biggest EB-2 move this month.
China (mainland-born) stayed at Oct 1, 2021, and India stayed at Nov 1, 2013. India's EB-2 Final Action Date is still the furthest back of the five chargeability areas.
The Final Action Date is the cutoff that controls when a green card can actually be approved. Chargeability is the country your case is counted under, which is usually your country of birth.

sections.heading: EB-2 Dates for Filing (Table B) did not change in November 2026
paragraphs: All five EB-2 Dates for Filing were the same as in October 2026. The date is Mar 15, 2026 for All other countries, Mexico and the Philippines, Jan 1, 2023 for China (mainland-born), and Jan 15, 2015 for India.

For November 2026, USCIS says employment-based applicants must use the Dates for Filing chart (Table B) to file Form I-485. If your priority date is earlier than the Table B date for your country, you may be able to file; other eligibility requirements still apply.

The Dates for Filing chart has a later cutoff date that runs ahead of Table A, so it can let you submit Form I-485 sooner when USCIS allows it. This month, Table B is 348 days (≈11.4 months) ahead of Table A for All other countries, Mexico and the Philippines. It is 457 days (≈15.0 months) ahead for China (mainland-born) and 440 days (≈14.5 months) ahead for India.

sections.heading: The 6- and 12-month EB-2 Final Action Date record by country
paragraphs: All other countries, Mexico and the Philippines have the same record. Over the last 6 bulletins (since May 2026), their Final Action Date went from Current (C) to Apr 1, 2025: it advanced in 1 bulletin, was unchanged in 4 and retrogressed in 1. Over the last 12 bulletins (since November 2025), it went from Dec 1, 2023 to Apr 1, 2025, a net +487 days (≈16.0 months). It advanced in 5 bulletins, was unchanged in 6 and retrogressed in 1.

China (mainland-born) moved from Sep 1, 2021 to Oct 1, 2021 over the last 6 bulletins, a net +30 days (≈1.0 months). It advanced in 1 and was unchanged in 5. Over the last 12 bulletins, it moved from Apr 1, 2021 to Oct 1, 2021, a net +183 days (≈6.0 months). It advanced in 3 and was unchanged in 9. China had no retrogressions in either period.

India moved from Jul 15, 2014 to Nov 1, 2013 over the last 6 bulletins, a net −256 days (≈8.4 months). It advanced in 1, was unchanged in 3 and retrogressed in 2. Over the last 12 bulletins, it moved from Apr 1, 2013 to Nov 1, 2013, a net +214 days (≈7.0 months). It advanced in 5, was unchanged in 5 and retrogressed in 2. India's date is behind where the 6-month window started but ahead of where the 12-month window started.
